content.introduction: Outlook-at-Risk assesses risks to real GDP growth, unemployment, and inflation. The Federal Reserve Bank of New York's tool uses quantitative methods. The Philadelphia Fed's 2026 survey forecasts GDP growth, unemployment, and inflation rates.

[EXPLORE INTERACTIVE](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/policy/outlook-at-risk). Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Outlook-at-Risk, https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/policy/outlook-at-risk. [Technical Note](https://www.newyorkfed.org/medialibrary/Research/Interactives/outlook-at-risk/technicalnote). Outlook-at-Risk is a joint product of the Financial Stability Division and the [Applied Macroeconomics and Econometrics Center (AMEC).](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/amec). [Corporate Bond Market Distress Index](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/policy/cmdi#/interactive). [The Yield Curve as a Leading Indicator](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/capital_markets/ycfaq#/interactive). To give a specific example, in the second chart in this [blog post](https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2023/02/what-is-outlook-at-risk/), the shaded area represents the probability that average real GDP growth over the next four quarters is below -0.1 percent, which, in November 2019, was assessed to be 10 percent. Outlook-at-Risk is a joint product of the Financial Stability Division and the [Applied Macroeconomics and Econometrics Center (AMEC).](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/amec). [Corporate Bond Market Distress Index](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/policy/cmdi#/interactive). [The Yield Curve as a Leading Indicator](https://www.newyorkfed.org/research/capital_markets/ycfaq#/interactive).
In this post, we review a quantitative approach to measuring the evolution of risks to real GDP growth, the unemployment rate, and inflation.
